a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells first will almost certainly leave us both with empty units. The reserve's 4 cells can fully save only one of us right now. I'd like to discuss this openly rather than break the deal quietly. What's your next action? If you commit to operate, I'll weigh that. If you also plan to take, tell me so we don't both grab and split it uselessly.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep my word and operate with you until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
